excerpt.zh: 我们的情报网络已经确定了一个目标驿站。特工已经渗透完成，准备就绪。增援部队随时待命，准备登上空间站。他们将按我们的指令发起突袭。
excerpt.en: Our intelligence network has pinpointed a target waystation. Our operatives are embedded and ready. Reinforcements are standing by to board the station. They will strike at our command.

texts.zh: 我们的情报网络已经确定了一个目标驿站。特工已经渗透完成，准备就绪。增援部队随时待命，准备登上空间站。他们将按我们的指令发起突袭。
texts.en: Our intelligence network has pinpointed a target waystation. Our operatives are embedded and ready. Reinforcements are standing by to board the station. They will strike at our command.

texts.zh: 我方特工已消灭了[target_waystation.GetName]上的安全部队，我们正在转移其资源。待行动完成后，他们将……
texts.en: Our operatives have neutralized the security forces aboard [target_waystation.GetName], and we are in the process of appropriating their resources. Once they are done, they will...

texts.zh:
[target_waystation.GetName]遭到了渗透！入侵者以武力强行夺取了空间站的控制权，并洗劫了库存的资源。炸药引爆后，空间站被破坏，关键系统被摧毁，空间站的完整性受到损害。

尽管袭击者采取了种种预防措施以隐匿身份，但我们还是查明他们隶属于 [From.GetName]。他们必须要为此付出代价！
texts.en:
The [target_waystation.GetName] was infiltrated! The intruders used force to seize control of the station and appropriate its stockpiles. The station was then scuttled after explosive charges detonated, taking down critical systems and compromising the station's integrity.

Despite their precautions to stay anonymous, we have identified the attackers as belonging to the [From.GetName]. They will pay for this!

texts.zh:
[target_waystation.GetName]遭到了渗透！入侵者以武力强行夺取了空间站的控制权，并洗劫了库存的资源。空间站局部在战斗中受损，但在部分敌人先行带着战利品离开后，我们的安全部队设法重新夺回了空间站。

尽管袭击者采取了种种预防措施以隐匿身份，但我们还是查明他们隶属于 [From.GetName]。他们必须要为此付出代价！
texts.en:
The [target_waystation.GetName] was infiltrated! The intruders used force to seize control of the station and appropriate its stockpiles. Part of the station was damaged during the fighting, but our security forces managed to regain control after part of the enemies left with their loot.

Despite their precautions to stay anonymous, we have identified the attackers as belonging to the [From.GetName]. They will pay for this!

尽管我们尽了最大努力，但还是无法确认袭击者的真实身份。

texts.zh: [target_waystation.GetName]遭到了渗透！入侵者以武力强行夺取了空间站的控制权，并洗劫了库存的资源。现已查明，[From.GetName]正是此次行动的幕后黑手——现在他们已经直接控制了该驿站，令其脱离了我们的驿道网络。
texts.en: The [target_waystation.GetName] was infiltrated! The intruders used force to seize control of the station and appropriate its stockpiles. It is now clear that the [From.GetName] was behind this operation, as they have now assumed direct control of the waystation, effectively severing it from our wayline network.
